nodes.text: I've been thinking about what you said. About getting myself sent to jail.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: The more I think about it, the more crazy I think it is. Getting sent to prison to jam with my band is insane.

nodes.text: Here's where I need your help. I'm never going to be able to get it in front of the right people without looking suspicious.

nodes.text: You look like the kinda' cat who knows people. Good and bad.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: I know I'm asking a lot, but if you could cast this to the wrong wind going in the right direction, I'd really appreciate it.

nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.text: If they get a whiff I'm trying to get sent to jazz-jail they'll send me somewhere else. Then I'm double fucked.
